blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation's Robinsons Las Piñas was honored with the Bronze Award in the Disability-Friendly Establishment category at the 31st Apolinario Mabini Awards, recognizing its commitment to creating safe, accessible, and inclusive spaces for persons with disabilities (PWDs). The recognition reflects Robinsons Land's continued commitment to developing destinations that are accessible, community-centered, and responsive to the diverse needs of Filipinos.

Presented by the Philippine Foundation for the Rehabilitation of the Disabled (PFRD), the Apolinario Mabini Awards is one of the country's longest-running recognition programs promoting the rights, welfare, and inclusion of persons with disabilities. The Disability-Friendly Establishment Award recognizes organizations that go beyond compliance by providing facilities, services, and environments that enable PWDs to navigate public spaces with dignity, independence, and confidence.

The recognition reflects Robinsons Land Corporation's belief that accessibility is fundamental to creating welcoming spaces where everyone can participate in community life. Through Robinsons Malls, the company continues to design and operate developments that are inclusive, and responsive to the diverse needs of its customers. As the heart of the communities it serves, Robinsons Malls is committed to creating environments where every individual can connect, participate, and thrive.

"We are honored to receive this recognition, which affirms our commitment to creating spaces that are accessible and inclusive for everyone," said Maria Kristina Real-Lim, Deputy Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Malls. "At Robinsons Malls, we believe every individual deserves to enjoy meaningful experiences in spaces designed with dignity, comfort, and accessibility in mind. Through thoughtful design, responsible operations, and meaningful partnerships, we continue to build communities where everyone feels welcome and empowered.”

Beyond its physical spaces, Robinsons Malls actively partners with government agencies, advocacy groups, and local communities to promote programs that advance inclusion, accessibility, and equal opportunity. These collaborations form part of the company's broader commitment to creating developments that generate lasting social value while improving everyday experiences for the communities it serves.

The recognition builds on Robinsons Malls' longstanding commitment to accessibility, following previous honors received by Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Galleria South at the Apolinario Mabini Awards. It further reflects the company's continued efforts to embed inclusivity into the way its malls are designed, operated, and experienced.

As Robinsons Land Corporation continues to expand its portfolio of Robinsons Malls across the country, it remains committed to creating destinations where everyone can connect, participate, and thrive. By championing accessible, inclusive, and community-centered developments, Robinsons Malls continues to build better lives while serving as a steady and dependable presence at the heart of the communities it serves.
